# Abbacy Global Group — Study Abroad & Overseas Education Consultancy

> Abbacy Global Group is Hyderabad's premier overseas education consultancy with 15+ years of operational excellence, an industry-leading 99.2% student visa success rate, and 10,000+ placed alumni across top global universities in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, France, Netherlands, and Dubai. Headquartered at Himayatnagar, Hyderabad, Abbacy provides 100% free personalized counseling, university shortlisting across 500+ global partner institutions, test preparation waivers (IELTS/PTE/GRE), collateral-free education loans up to ₹50 Lakhs, Telangana ePASS ₹20 Lakhs scholarship assistance, and daily 1-on-1 consular mock interviews.

## Country Destinations & Intake Guides (Fall 2026 / Spring 2027)

- [Study in USA Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-usa.html): Complete guide to American universities, F-1 visa approvals, STEM OPT (up to 36 months work authorization), GRE waivers, Day-1 CPT policies, and average starting salaries ($85,000–$120,000/yr).
- [Study in UK Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-uk.html): Intensive 1-year Master's programs, Russell Group university admissions (Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, UCL), 2-year post-study Graduate Route work visa, CAS issuance, and £2,000–£10,000 merit scholarships.
- [Study in Canada Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-canada.html): 2026/2027 IRCC rules, Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) process, Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP up to 3 years), Co-op work programs, and Express Entry PR score building.
- [Study in Australia Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-australia.html): Group of Eight (Go8) university applications, Subclass 500 student visa, Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate work rights, regional migration incentives, and high minimum wage protections.
- [Study in Germany Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-germany.html): Tuition-free education (€0 tuition) at public universities (TU9), mandatory APS certificate verification, €11,904/year blocked account (Ausländerbehörde requirement), and 18-month Job Seeker Visa.
- [Study in Ireland Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-ireland.html): Europe's English-speaking tech capital (Silicon Docks Dublin), 1-year Master's, 2-year Stamp 1G post-study work visa, and fast-track Critical Skills Employment Permits.
- [Study in France Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-france.html): Subsidized tuition (€2,770–€3,770/yr) at public universities, Grande École business schools, CAF accommodation housing allowance (up to 40% rent rebate), and 5-year post-study Schengen circulation visa.
- [Study in Netherlands Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-netherlands.html): Over 2,100 English-taught programs, 1-year Zoekjaar (Orientation Year) work visa, high graduate employment in European tech hubs (Amsterdam, Eindhoven).
- [Study in Dubai Guide](https://abbacy.in/study-in-dubai.html): International branch campuses (Heriot-Watt, Wollongong, Birmingham, Middlesex), 0% personal income tax, fast 15-day visa approval without IELTS, and direct GCC employment opportunities.

## Critical Student Support Hubs

- [Scholarship Portal & Telangana ePASS Guide](https://abbacy.in/guide-scholarships.html): Eligibility rules and documentation for Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi (SC/ST) and Mahatma Jyothiba Phule BC Overseas Scholarship (up to ₹20,00,000 grants plus one-way airfare), plus global institutional merit discounts.
- [Collateral-Free Education Loan Guide](https://abbacy.in/guide-loans.html): Unsecured education loans up to ₹50–60 Lakhs, secured loans up to ₹1.5 Crore via SBI, HDFC Credila, Axis Bank, Avanse, and international non-collateral lenders (Prodigy Finance, MPOWER Financing).
- [English Language Exam Matrix (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL/Duolingo)](https://abbacy.in/guide-ielts.html): Score benchmarks (IELTS 6.5+, PTE 58+, DET 115+), band comparisons, preparation modules, and official Medium of Instruction (MOI) waiver pathways.
- [US Master's Application Roadmap](https://abbacy.in/guide-usa.html): Month-by-month timeline for Fall and Spring intakes, SOP/LOR drafting criteria, I-20 financial documentation, and DS-160 interview question frameworks.
- [Online Profile Eligibility Evaluator](https://abbacy.in/eligibility.html): Instant 60-second evaluation engine matching GPA/percentage, backlog count, budget, and test scores to global university admission criteria.
- [Contact & Walk-In Consultation Booking](https://abbacy.in/contact.html): Book a 1-on-1 counseling session with a senior study abroad director or locate our nearest Hyderabad office.
